section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch23 — Geography — Deep Practice 4
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Black (regur) soil, ideal for growing cotton, is most extensively found in which region of India?

options.option_text: The Deccan Plateau (Maharashtra, parts of AP/Telangana, Madhya Pradesh)

explanation: Black/regur soil, formed from weathered basaltic lava, covers much of the Deccan Plateau and is especially suited to cotton cultivation — hence its name 'black cotton soil'.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch23 — Geography — Deep Practice 4
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands, an Indian Union Territory, are located in which body of water?

options.option_text: Indian Ocean, but specifically off the Gujarat coast

explanation: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands lie in the Bay of Bengal. The Lakshadweep Islands, by contrast, lie in the Arabian Sea off the Kerala coast.
